scap.translation: abbr. scapula 肩胛骨; scapular 肩胛（骨）; 肩绷带; scapuloid 肩胛骨形的

scapa.translation: abbr. Society for Checking the Abuses of Public Advertizing <英>制止滥用广告协会

scapas.translation: (scapa 的复数) abbr. Society for Checking the Abuses of Public Advertizing <英>制止滥用广告协会

scape.definition: n. erect leafless flower stalk growing directly from the ground as in a tulip

scapegoat.definition: n. someone who is punished for the errors of others
scapegoat.translation:
n. 替罪羔羊, 替人顶罪者, 替身
[法] 替罪羊, 代人受过者

scapegoated.definition:
past participle of scapegoat
n. someone who is punished for the errors of others
scapegoated.translation:
(scapegoat 的过去分词) n. 替罪羔羊, 替人顶罪者, 替身
[法] 替罪羊, 代人受过者

scapegoating.translation: v. 使成为替罪羊( scapegoat的现在分词 )

scapegoatism.translation:
n. 抛出替罪羊
[法] 抛出替罪羊, 卸罪

scapegoats.definition: n. someone who is punished for the errors of others
scapegoats.translation:
n. 代人受过的人, 替罪羊( scapegoat的复数形式 )
v. 使成为替罪羊( scapegoat的第三人称单数 )

scapegrace.definition: n. a reckless and unprincipled reprobate
scapegrace.translation:
n. 不可救药的恶棍, 饭桶
[法] 恶棍, 无赖, 流氓

scapes.definition:
-s form of scape
n. erect leafless flower stalk growing directly from the ground as in a tulip
scapes.translation: (scape 的第三人称 -s形式) [医] 柄节(昆虫)

scaphander.definition:
n. The case, or impermeable apparel, in which a diver can
   work while under water.

scaphiopus.translation: [网络] 锄足蟾属；掘足蟾属

scaphite.definition:
n. Any fossil cephalopod shell of the genus Scaphites,
   belonging to the Ammonite family and having a chambered boat-shaped
   shell. Scaphites are found in the Cretaceous formation.

scaphocephalic.definition: a. Of, pertaining to, or affected with, scaphocephaly.

scaphocephaly.definition: n congenital malformation of the skull which is long and narrow; frequently accompanied by mental retardation

scaphocerite.definition:
n. A flattened plate or scale attached to the second
   joint of the antennae of many Crustacea.
scaphocerite.translation: 第二触角鳞片(虾), 触角鳞

scaphognathite.definition:
n. A thin leafike appendage (the exopodite) of the
   second maxilla of decapod crustaceans. It serves as a pumping organ to
   draw the water through the gill cavity.

scaphoid.translation:
a. 船状的, 舟状的
n. 舟状骨

scapholunar.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the scaphoid and lunar bones of
   the carpus.
n. The scapholunar bone.

scaphopoda.definition: n. small class of bilaterally symmetrical marine forms comprising the tooth shells

scapiform.definition: a. Resembling a scape, or flower stem.

scaping.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Scape
scaping.translation: abbr. Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (第二次世界大战时期驻日本的)盟军最高统帅

scapolite.definition:
n. A grayish white mineral occuring in tetragonal crystals
   and in cleavable masses. It is essentially a silicate of alumina and
   soda.

scapose.definition: s resembling or consisting of a scape; having a bare leafless stalk growing directly from the ground
scapose.translation: [植]具花葶的, 有根生花梗的

scapped.translation: (scap 的过去时) abbr. scapula 肩胛骨; scapular 肩胛（骨）; 肩绷带; scapuloid 肩胛骨形的

scapple.definition:
v. t. To work roughly, or shape without finishing, as stone
   before leaving the quarry.
v. t. To dress in any way short of fine tooling or rubbing,
   as stone.
scapple.translation: v. (将石)粗加整修,(使石)初具形态

scapula.definition: n. either of two flat triangular bones one on each side of the shoulder in human beings
scapula.translation:
n. 肩胛, 肩胛骨
[医] 肩胛[骨], 肩板(昆虫)

scapulae.translation: n. 肩胛骨( scapula的名词复数 )

scapular.definition:
n. a feather covering the shoulder of a bird
n. garment consisting of a long wide piece of woolen cloth worn over the shoulders with an opening for the head; part of a monastic habit
a. relating to or near the shoulder blade
scapular.translation:
n. 肩胛, 肩胛骨, 肩绷带
a. 肩胛骨的

scapular points.translation: [医] 肩胛点(臂神经痛点,在肩胛下角处)

scapular reflex.translation: [医] 肩胛反射, 肩胛间肌反射

scapulars.definition:
plural of scapular
n. a feather covering the shoulder of a bird
n. garment consisting of a long wide piece of woolen cloth worn over the shoulders with an opening for the head; part of a monastic habit
a. relating to or near the shoulder blade
scapulars.translation:
(scapular 的复数) n. 肩胛, 肩胛骨, 肩绷带
a. 肩胛骨的

scapulary.definition: n garment consisting of a long wide piece of woolen cloth worn over the shoulders with an opening for the head; part of a monastic habit

scapulas.translation: n. 肩胛骨( scapula的名词复数 )

scapulet.definition:
n. A secondary mouth fold developed at the base of each of
   the armlike lobes of the manubrium of many rhizostome medusae. See
   Illustration in Appendix.

scapulo-.definition:
A combining form used in anatomy to indicate connection
   with, or relation to, the scapula or the shoulder; as, the
   scapulo-clavicular articulation, the articulation between the scapula
   and clavicle.

scapulo-anterior.translation: [医] 肩前位(横产胎位之一)

scapulohumeral.definition: a relating to the shoulder blade and upper arm bone

scapulohumeral type.translation: [医] 肩胛肱型(进行性脊髓肌萎缩的一型)

scapuloposterior.translation: [医] 肩后位(横产胎位之一)
